== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-wedgeantilles-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Wedge Antilles (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (by 28 December 2016): Same game text. This is a slip again: the lower part of the card with a black strip under the text box carrying a white italic “E” but no title.

The same area of the earlier card image (scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
